cna.title: supergateway: Cross-Site WebSocket Hijacking in stdio-to-WebSocket mode

descriptions.value: The stdio-to-WebSocket mode of supergateway through 4.2.2 (commit 5ad19d3) accepts WebSocket upgrade requests from any Origin and does not require authentication by default (src/gateways/stdioToWs.ts). WebSocket handshakes are not subject to the same-origin policy, so any page a victim visits can connect to ws://127.0.0.1:<port>/ws, initialize an MCP session and invoke tools such as filesystem reads or shell-backed operations with the victim's privileges. Origins including http://evil.example, null, https://attacker.test:4443 and http://localhost:9999 were accepted; exfiltration of a local file was demonstrated in a real browser (12/12 runs). Enabling SUPERGATEWAY_API_KEY causes unauthenticated upgrades to be refused.

references.name: Research repository with PoC, evidence and browser proof

timeline.value: Vulnerability discovered and reproduced, including real-browser proof
